newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE approves Minneapolis/Duluth oats deliveries.
newsitem.headline: WCE approves Minneapolis/Duluth oats deliveries.

text.p: The Winnipeg Commodity Exchange (WCE) said it approved Minneapolis and Duluth, Minnesota, as delivery locations for the WCE oats futures contract beginning with the March 1997 oats contract.

The WCE said its membership voted to accept deliveries with the main reference point in-store Minneapolis and alternate deliveries in Duluth and multiple western Canadian locations. Par grade is Canadian Number 3 Western oats.
The WCE oats contract has been inactive, with open interest as of Thursday only 20 contracts in the WCE October and 330 in the December positions.
Minneapolis is the center of the main cash market for U.S. oats and also the main delivery point for the Chicago Board of Trade's oats futures contract.
